harness.name: h1-brain
harness.description: MCP server linking an AI assistant to HackerOne bug bounty history, scopes and reports.

uses.quote: The primary tool, `hack(handle)`, generates a full hacking session briefing in a single call: fresh scope from the API, your past findings, public disclosures for that program, weakness patterns, untouched assets, and suggested attack vectors — all formatted as actionable instructions that put the AI in offensive mode.
